def _build_stage3_dam(sandbox, density):
    x_left = 12.5
    x_middle = 13.0
    x_right = 13.5
    beam_w = sandbox.MAX_BEAM_WIDTH
    max_h = sandbox.MAX_BEAM_HEIGHT
    min_bottom_y = sandbox.MIN_BEAM_BOTTOM_Y
    left_layer_h = min(0.7, max_h)
    left_n = 10
    left_first_y = min_bottom_y + left_layer_h / 2
    left_beams = []
    for i in range(left_n):
        cy = left_first_y + i * left_layer_h
        b = sandbox.add_beam(x_left, cy, width=beam_w, height=left_layer_h, angle=0, density=density)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(b, restitution=0.05)
        left_beams.append(b)
    for i in range(1, left_n):
        y_anchor = (left_beams[i].position.y + left_beams[i - 1].position.y) / 2
        sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[i], left_beams[i - 1], (x_left, y_anchor), type='rigid')
    middle_h = min(0.6, max_h)
    middle_y = 6.0
    middle_beam = sandbox.add_beam(x_middle, middle_y, width=beam_w, height=middle_h, angle=0, density=density)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(middle_beam, restitution=0.05)
    right_layer_h = min(1.5, max_h)
    right_n = 2
    right_first_y = min_bottom_y + right_layer_h / 2
    right_beams = []
    for i in range(right_n):
        cy = right_first_y + i * right_layer_h
        b = sandbox.add_beam(x_right, cy, width=beam_w, height=right_layer_h, angle=0, density=density)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(b, restitution=0.05)
        right_beams.append(b)
    sandbox.add_joint(right_beams[1], right_beams[0], (x_right, (right_beams[1].position.y + right_beams[0].position.y) / 2), type='rigid')
    top_left = left_beams[-1]
    anchor_left_mid_x = (x_left + x_middle) / 2
    anchor_left_mid_y = (top_left.position.y + middle_beam.position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(top_left, middle_beam, (anchor_left_mid_x, anchor_left_mid_y), type='rigid')
    anchor_mid_right_x = (x_middle + x_right) / 2
    anchor_mid_right_y = (middle_beam.position.y + right_beams[1].position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(middle_beam, right_beams[1], (anchor_mid_right_x, anchor_mid_right_y), type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[0], right_beams[0], (13.5, (left_beams[0].position.y + right_beams[0].position.y) / 2), type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[2], right_beams[1], (13.5, (left_beams[2].position.y + right_beams[1].position.y) / 2), type='rigid')
    sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[7], right_beams[1], (13.5, (left_beams[7].position.y + right_beams[1].position.y) / 2), type='rigid')
    return left_beams[0]

def build_agent(sandbox):
    # Define build strips and constraints
    left_strip = (12.4, 12.6)
    middle_strip = (12.9, 13.1)
    right_strip = (13.4, 13.6)
    min_y = sandbox.MIN_BEAM_BOTTOM_Y
    max_beam_width = sandbox.MAX_BEAM_WIDTH
    max_beam_height = sandbox.MAX_BEAM_HEIGHT
    density = 46.0  # Adjusted for mass budget and stability

    # Ensure vertical band coverage (3 beams per band)
    # Left strip: 8 beams distributed across vertical bands
    left_beams = []
    # Lower band (0.5-2.5 m): 3 beams
    for y in [0.75, 1.5, 2.25]:
        b = sandbox.add_beam(12.5, y, width=max_beam_width, height=0.5, density=density)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(b, restitution=0.05)
        left_beams.append(b)
    # Middle band (2.5-5 m): 3 beams
    for y in [3.0, 3.75, 4.5]:
        b = sandbox.add_beam(12.5, y, width=max_beam_width, height=0.5, density=density)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(b, restitution=0.05)
        left_beams.append(b)
    # Upper band (5-7.5 m): 2 beams
    for y in [5.5, 6.5]:
        b = sandbox.add_beam(12.5, y, width=max_beam_width, height=0.5, density=density)
        sandbox.set_material_properties(b, restitution=0.05)
        left_beams.append(b)

    # Connect left strip beams vertically
    for i in range(1, len(left_beams)):
        y_anchor = (left_beams[i].position.y + left_beams[i-1].position.y) / 2
        sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[i], left_beams[i-1], (12.5, y_anchor), type='rigid')

    # Right strip: 2 beams distributed across vertical bands
    right_beams = []
    # Middle band (2.5-5 m): 1 beam
    b = sandbox.add_beam(13.5, 3.75, width=max_beam_width, height=0.5, density=density)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(b, restitution=0.05)
    right_beams.append(b)
    # Upper band (5-7.5 m): 1 beam
    b = sandbox.add_beam(13.5, 6.5, width=max_beam_width, height=0.5, density=density)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(b, restitution=0.05)
    right_beams.append(b)

    # Connect right strip beams vertically
    sandbox.add_joint(right_beams[1], right_beams[0], (13.5, (right_beams[1].position.y + right_beams[0].position.y) / 2), type='rigid')

    # Middle strip: 1 beam in upper band
    middle_beam = sandbox.add_beam(13.0, 6.5, width=max_beam_width, height=0.5, density=density)
    sandbox.set_material_properties(middle_beam, restitution=0.05)

    # Add diagonal bracing in lower third (y < 2.5 m) for lateral stability
    # Connect lower left beams to right beams
    for left_beam in left_beams:
        if left_beam.position.y < 2.5:
            for right_beam in right_beams:
                if right_beam.position.y < 2.5:
                    anchor_x = (left_beam.position.x + right_beam.position.x) / 2
                    anchor_y = (left_beam.position.y + right_beam.position.y) / 2
                    sandbox.add_joint(left_beam, right_beam, (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='rigid')

    # Connect upper left beams to middle beam
    for left_beam in left_beams[-2:]:
        anchor_x = (left_beam.position.x + middle_beam.position.x) / 2
        anchor_y = (left_beam.position.y + middle_beam.position.y) / 2
        sandbox.add_joint(left_beam, middle_beam, (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='rigid')

    # Connect middle beam to upper right beam
    anchor_x = (middle_beam.position.x + right_beams[1].position.x) / 2
    anchor_y = (middle_beam.position.y + right_beams[1].position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(middle_beam, right_beams[1], (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='rigid')

    # Connect middle left beam to middle right beam
    anchor_x = (left_beams[3].position.x + right_beams[0].position.x) / 2
    anchor_y = (left_beams[3].position.y + right_beams[0].position.y) / 2
    sandbox.add_joint(left_beams[3], right_beams[0], (anchor_x, anchor_y), type='rigid')

    return left_beams[0]
